text:
jordan: Quick bug report from onboarding: the python sample app async tool/function call path fails when the tool returns a dataclass. Repro on redwood==0.14.2 in our sample image.

jordan: Minimal repro (async):
```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient

client = AsyncClient(api_key=ENV_TOKEN)

@dataclass
class Person:
    name: str
    age: int

async def main():
    out = await client.call_tool(name=\"fmt_person\", input={\"raw\": \"A, 30\"}, response_schema=Person)
    return out
```

mai: What error do you see?

jordan: Short stack: TypeError: failed to coerce dataclass to json in _struct._serialize. Happens only on async client; sync works fine.

(taylor): I hit this too while testing sample-app. Workaround was `return asdict(obj)` inside the tool. But that makes the sample's return type Dict and breaks mypy/editor hints for new devs which is annoying for onboarding.

devtools: I dug into the runtime: async coercion runs in a ThreadPoolExecutor and we accidentally drop our serializer hooks, so dataclass handling isn't applied. Also observed a flakey auth-refresh + retry path that can surface as a serialization error and confuse root cause analysis.

mai: Proposed fixes?

devtools: 1) Run the coercer on the event loop (avoid threadpool) or propagate hooks into the executor; 2) harden token-refresh retry for toolcall so 401s don't get masked as serialization failures; 3) add a CI matrix entry for sample-app that exercises sync/async x dataclass/dict returns.

jordan: Strong +1 on the CI test. This would have caught it earlier. Also can we improve the error message when coercion fails so we say \"unsupported return type: dataclass\" instead of a generic TypeError? Less confusing for new users.

taylor: Agreed. Short-term docs/workaround: update sample README to show dict return in the main example and include a commented dataclass example with a note about the workaround. That reduces confusion until we ship a patch.

devtools: I'll open a hotfix PR with tests and a changelog entry. Plan to cut 0.14.3 today if all green.

ci-bot: build/sample-app (python-matrix) queued for commit hotfix/async-dataclass -> job #5220

devtools: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4107 - includes fix to coercer, retry hardening, improved error text, and sample-app CI matrix. Marked hotfix.

jordan: Verified locally against the PR branch: async toolcall now accepts dataclass returns and editors/mypy are happy. Thanks!

mai: I'll update the onboarding guide and add a short note in the API docs about recommended return shapes until the release is cut.

jordan: Closing loop for now. Ping me or @devtools if you see any more async-toolcall oddities.
